name: Neo4j MCP
description: Gives agents structured access to a Neo4j graph database over MCP to read the schema and run read or write Cypher queries, via STDIO or an HTTP mode.

skills.name: Schema Introspection
skills.description: Introspects node labels, relationship types, and property keys with get-schema so an agent can reason about the data model.

skills.name: Read-Only Cypher
skills.description: Runs read-only Cypher queries, enforced via EXPLAIN and Neo4j's query-type classification, to retrieve nodes and paths.

skills.name: Write Cypher
skills.description: Runs write Cypher queries to create or update graph data, and is disabled when NEO4J_MCP_READ_ONLY is set to true.

skills.name: GDS Procedure Listing
skills.description: Lists available Graph Data Science procedures, and is turned off automatically when the GDS library is not installed.
